The '''sabotage of the ''Endurance''''' was planned and carried out by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who sought revenge on [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] for [[Death/Legends|killing]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|his father]]. He first disguised himself as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] cadet nicknamed "Lucky" and went to the ''[[Endurance/Legends|Endurance]]'' with the [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]] under the command of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Crasher/Legends|Crasher]].

His first attempt to kill Windu was to place a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] in his quarters; however, this failed to kill the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. He then attempted destroy the core command console. He succeeded, stunning a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the process. The resulting explosion crippled the ''Endurance'', sending it crashing into [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]]. Fett and the clone cadets escaped in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] when [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] and [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] picked Boba up in the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]. Fett escaped with Sing and Bossk, and the cadets were later found by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. However, Windu was not killed.
